page.overview:
Who is Fiedra Marrow?

is a halfling kitchen worker and rogue played by Jasmine Don in Exandria Unlimited: Divergence.

Fiedra was small for a halfling, scrawny, wiry, and tough-looking, with red hair worn in two pigtails. She had a tattoo of a cockroach on her shoulder. When first seen, she looked as though she hadn't been sleeping well recently.

Fiedra grew up orphaned in a city, and at some point became the leader of a gang there. At around age 13, she acquired a "dragon egg" (winning it in a game of cards), and when it hatched into Crokas, she raised him. When Crokas was ten or eleven, they were both captured and brought to Rybad-Kol, where Fiedra worked in its kitchen, the Slop, gaining some amount of control there, and the trust of at least one of the guards. Crokas acted as a bodyguard to Fiedra. They worked in the kitchen for four or five years, and with several other workers formed their own gang, the Roaches..}}
